modules.name: SpaceTime Program
modules.description: 64-stage, eight-head SpaceTime engine with integrated MIDI -- the MetaModule twin of VCV's Program, merged with Core

modules.name: SpaceTime Timing Monitor
modules.description: Diagnostic clock-to-stage timing monitor for eight SpaceTime heads

modules.name: SpaceTime Head
modules.description: Relocated SpaceTime head: runs its own Function Generator, bound to a Program over the shared-memory bus. Slug matches VCV's real Head (mechanics differ: bus-bound, not expander-chained)

modules.name: SpaceTime Stage4
modules.description: Publishes 4 stages' voltage/time to a Program over the shared-memory bus; owns no data. Slug matches VCV's real Stage4 (mechanics differ: bus-bound, not expander-chained, no local program-word storage)

modules.name: SpaceTime Midi
modules.description: Read-only MIDI activity and channel monitor for a Program, matching VCV's separate Midi module's slug (mechanics differ: read-only, no device queues)
